next_falsifier: On exact current Frank procedural traces, compare latest-version/supersession, provenance+recency, explicit denoising/aggregation and any utility memory candidate. Only revisit CMX if a predeclared case shows unique defect coverage or Pareto gain and the counterfactual-coupon/rent ablations become positive.
primary_result: Counterfactual coupon and rent are not causally supported by ablations. Strong newest-verified baseline wins from 0-10% evidence noise and is ~10x faster than CMX in the local selection microbench. CMX only crosses latest at 15% noise, where its defining ablations still fail.
useful_delta: For Frank v0.1 F-V01-11, make version/provenance/supersession the first memory baseline and keep procedural utility separate from factual/identity/authority memory. Do not implement CMX unless a real procedural-memory benchmark defeats simpler denoising/versioned baselines.
